key_highlights: ASX opens lower on Middle East oil surge and US equity wobble; CSL.AX gains on Trump-administration medicine pricing deal
Coal sector booms as 'lucky country' narrative returns, offsetting iron ore softness
Sydney house price crash gains global attention; property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes
Global debt spiral and AI contagion risk flagged by top central bankers as macro headwinds
Qantas ground crews vote for strike right amid pay dispute; Star bleeds $307m with auditor survival doubts
Rare earths and uranium exploration activity accelerates across WA, NT, and international projects
Australian inflation confirmed as domestically driven, complicating RBA policy path

sectors.trend: Mixed: coal boom lifts energy miners; iron ore under pressure ('roaches seeth'); rare earths (Lindian, Barkly) and gold (Great Southern, Kaiser) see active exploration catalysts
sectors.implications: Rotation from iron ore (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) toward coal (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) and critical minerals (LRE.AX, BKY.AX, GSG.AX). Diversification within materials is key.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX supported by US pricing deal but long-term margin pressure from Trump-administration price slashing; weight-loss drug demand surging domestically
sectors.implications: Near-term positive for CSL.AX sentiment, but structural margin compression risk. GLP-1 demand tailwind benefits CSL.AX and domestic pharma supply chains.

sectors.trend: Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes; Star ($307m loss, auditor doubts) and Bathla (potential collapse) signal stress in property-linked credit
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk in property segment. Macquarie (MQG.AX) $700m KPMG audit bid adds governance scrutiny. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Oil surges on US-Iran flare-up; diesel shock described as permanent; Danish wind farm entry addresses Australia's renewable pipeline gap
sectors.implications: Positive for oil-exposed names (WDS.AX, LSE.AX) and energy transition plays. Diesel cost inflation pressures transport and logistics margins.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) ground crew strike vote creates operational risk; 'dupe' brand trend and EV uptake signal shifting consumer behaviour; Star (SGH.AX) in distress
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces near-term disruption risk. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) benefit from dupe-brand value shift. EV uptake supports battery and charging infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: Sydney house price crash goes global; negative gearing reform fails to ignite rent spike; renter respite emerges; property credit contraction underway
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face mixed signals: softer rents but policy support. Housing construction names under pressure. Monitor RBA response to domestic inflation.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil risk (US-Iran) driving energy inflation and ASX volatility
Domestic inflation as primary RBA constraint, limiting rate-cut flexibility
Property credit contraction post-budget tax changes creating financial sector stress
Critical minerals and rare earths exploration wave (WA, NT, Kazakhstan)
AI contagion risk flagged by central bankers as systemic concern
Global debt spiral undermining confidence in risk assets
CSL US pricing deal: short-term catalyst vs long-term margin risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / US-Iran escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; maintain cash buffers; monitor Brent crude above $85/bbl trigger

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property credit contraction and developer defaults (Star, Bathla)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to property-linked credit; favour banks with diversified loan books (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor for contagion to other transport operators

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global debt spiral and AI-driven economic contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain defensive allocation; favour quality dividend payers; reduce leverage
Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and growth; favour value and income strategies

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US pricing deal margin compression
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor CSL.AX earnings guidance; assess deal terms for 12-24 month margin impact

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and energy miners on oil surge and coal boom
opportunities.rationale: Coal demand resilient; oil at elevated levels on geopolitical risk; WDS and LSE benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Selective rare earths and critical minerals exposure
opportunities.rationale: Multiple exploration catalysts (Lindian, Barkly, Great Southern) signal sector re-rating; policy tailwinds

opportunities.recommendation: CSL.AX tactical buy on US deal catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Short-term sentiment boost from Trump-administration deal; weight-loss drug demand provides structural tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Wind/renewable infrastructure plays on Danish entry
opportunities.rationale: Danish giant addresses Australia's wind farm drought; policy support for energy transition

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property-linked credit and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit growth crash, developer distress (Star, Bathla), and Sydney price crash create elevated default risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim QAN.AX ahead of potential strike action
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty in near term

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and quality dividend income as hedge to debt spiral
defensive_moves.rationale: Global debt spiral and AI contagion risk warrant defensive positioning; favour CBA.AX, WES.AX dividends

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid iron ore concentration; diversify materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore under pressure; rotation toward coal, gold, and critical minerals offers better risk-adjusted returns

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months: oil volatility, property credit stress, Qantas industrial risk, and domestic inflation stickiness cap upside. CSL.AX and coal names provide selective pockets of strength. ^AXJO likely to trade in a range with downside bias until RBA signals rate-cut flexibility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if property credit stabilises and RBA eases. Critical minerals, energy transition, and healthcare (GLP-1 demand) offer structural growth. Global debt spiral and AI disruption remain wildcard risks. Iron ore recovery dependent on China stimulus.
